extracted.intended_audience: Authors and contributors (members and non-members) preparing submissions for the London Mathematical Society Newsletter
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for preparing and submitting content (feature articles, micro‑theses, news, event notices, reviews, obituaries, etc.) to the London Mathematical Society Newsletter, including deadlines, file formats, permissions, and template use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content types accepted / scope
rubrics_metrics.description: The Newsletter welcomes submissions of feature content, including mathematical articles, career-related articles, and micro-theses, from members and non-members.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Additional item types referenced include news items, notices of events, book reviews, events, obituaries, reports of LMS events, and visits. Different item types have dedicated templates. News items should be sent to newsletter@lms.ac.uk and notices of events to calendar@lms.ac.uk.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission deadlines / timeliness
rubrics_metrics.description: The Newsletter is published four times per year (February, May, September and December). The deadlines to submit new content for the forthcoming issues are given; new content submitted after the deadline may not be accepted for the issue.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific upcoming deadlines listed on the page: May 2026 — Submissions have closed; September 2026 — 10 July 2026; December 2026 — 16 October 2026; February 2027 — Not open for submissions. Authors should submit by the stated deadline for the target issue.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission contacts / where to send
rubrics_metrics.description: Feature content should be submitted to the editor-in-chief, Alina Vdovina, at newsletter.editor@lms.ac.uk, CC'ing newsletter@lms.ac.uk.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: News items should be sent to newsletter@lms.ac.uk and notices of events to calendar@lms.ac.uk. Once accepted, send the LaTeX file to newsletter@lms.ac.uk. Use the specified email addresses for the appropriate item type to ensure correct handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Format preference: LaTeX required when possible; Word acceptable if necessary
rubrics_metrics.description: The LMS Newsletter is prepared in LaTeX and submissions should be prepared in LaTeX when possible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For those not familiar with LaTeX, the Newsletter can accept submissions in Word. However, once a submission has been accepted for publication, authors are asked to provide the LaTeX version of their article to the Newsletter Editorial Office (i.e., Word may be accepted initially but LaTeX is required upon acceptance).

rubrics_metrics.name: Images and maths imagery: separate high-resolution files
rubrics_metrics.description: If your submission includes photographs or maths imagery, please include those as separate files, in high resolution, in the sources files bundle.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Photographs and figures should not be embedded only in the main document; provide separate source image files at high resolution as part of the submission bundle to facilitate publication quality reproduction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Permissions and copyright responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: All sources for the article (text, images, photographs) must be clearly disclosed and permissions obtained from the original authors, creators and original publishers, if they hold the copyright, for any figures or significant extracts that are to be reproduced or quoted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The copyright of photographs is owned by the photographer unless formally assigned in writing. Collection of such permissions is the responsibility of the authors; authors must ensure they have the right to reproduce quoted extracts or figures and must disclose source information.

rubrics_metrics.name: LaTeX templates and technical requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: LaTeX templates for various article types are provided; each download contains the Newsletter’s class file and a template that contains author guidance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should use the appropriate template for their article type (feature articles, microtheses, book reviews, events, obituaries, reports of LMS events, visits). Note that the class file requires a recent TeX installation to compile—authors must ensure their TeX distribution is up-to-date to build the provided templates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Post-acceptance file submission procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Once accepted, please send the file in LaTeX at newsletter@lms.ac.uk.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Even if an initial submission was supplied in Word due to unfamiliarity with LaTeX, the accepted manuscript should be converted to and provided as a LaTeX source bundle (including high-resolution images and any other source files) for final production.
